headline: Approved eight bid awards and contracts for lead abatement, vehicles, trailers, and public works projects, all by 5-0 votes.
summary: The Finance Committee approved bids for lead abatement at two properties, a police patrol vehicle, an equipment trailer, the Cross Canal Connector project, a pump station design task order, a railroad crossing utility project, and a dump truck purchase. All items passed by 5-0 votes.
decisions: Awarded bid 2026-034 for Lead Abatement of 178-180 Blake St. to RC Group, Biddeford, ME, for $116,000, including the $6,000 owner match. Vote 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-035 for Lead Abatement of 165-167 Bartlett St. to RC Group, Biddeford, ME, for $89,950, including the $12,000 owner match. Vote 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-042 for one police patrol vehicle to Quirk Ford, Augusta, ME, for $45,012. Vote 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-041 for one 30-ton tri-axle equipment trailer for Public Works to Hale Trailer, Portland, ME, for $61,209. Vote 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-037 for the Cross Canal Connector project to Starrett Snow and Landscape, Raymond, ME, for an estimated $147,827.02. Vote 5-0.
Authorized a Task Order for Preliminary Design Services for the Randall Road Pump Station with Tighe & Bond for an amount not to exceed $88,000. Vote 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-040 for the Whipple and Middle St. Utility Railroad Crossings project to Starrett Snow and Landscape, Raymond, ME, for an estimated $904,585.58. Vote 5-0.
Authorized a Waiver of Competition with Freightliner of Maine to purchase a 6-wheeled dump truck cab and chassis with a Viking-Cives body for the Sewer Dept. for $159,050. Vote 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: (115-2026) To award bid 2026-034 for the Lead Abatement of 178-180 Blake St. to RC Group, Biddeford, ME, at their bid price of $116,000, including the $6,000 owner match.

(116-2026) To award bid 2026-035 for the Lead Abatement of 165-167 Bartlett St. to RC Group, Biddeford, ME, at their bid price of $89,950, including the $12,000 owner match provided by the CDBG rehab program funding.
(117-2026) To award bid 2026-042 for one (1) police patrol vehicle to Quirk Ford, Augusta, ME, at their bid price of $45,012.
(118-2026) To award bid 2026-041 for one (1) 30-ton tri-axle equipment trailer for Public Works to Hale Trailer, Portland, ME, at their bid price of $61,209 for a Manac 30T air ramp tag trailer.

(119-2026) To award bid 2026-037 for the Cross Canal Connector project to Starrett Snow and Landscape, Raymond, ME, at their estimated bid price of $147,827.02 based on itemized costs using estimated quantities prepared by the Project Engineer.
(120-2026) To authorize the Task Order for Preliminary Design Services for the Randall Road Pump Station with Tighe & Bond for an amount not to exceed $88,000.

(121-2026) To award bid 2026-040 for the Whipple and Middle St. Utility Railroad Crossings project to Starrett Snow and Landscape, Raymond, ME, for an estimated bid amount of $904,585.58 based on itemized costs using estimated quantities prepared by the Assistant City Engineer.

(122-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition with Freightliner of Maine to purchase a 6-wheeled dump truck cab and chassis with a Viking-Cives provided body for the Sewer Dept. at their Sourcewell contract price of $159,050.

plain_text:
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
Lewiston, ME 
Minutes of  
August 10, 2026 
 
PRESENT: Chairman Chittim, Councilor Nagine, Mr. Bouh, Ms. McCabe, and Ms. Hoskins  
 
ABSENT: N/A 
 
OTHERS PRESENT: Deputy Director of Budget and Purchasing, Allen Ward , City Engineer, 
Jeff Beaule , Fleet Operations Manager, Phil Brienza, and Assistant Community Development 
Manager, Jaqueline Sawyer 
  
The meeting was called to order at 5:31 p.m.  
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(114-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated July 27, 2026, and to accept and 
place them on file by the Clerk. 
VOTE: 4-0 
Councilor Nagine arrived at 5:38 p.m. 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(115-2026) To award bid 2026-034 for the Lead Abatement of 178 -180 Blake St. to RC Group, 
Biddeford, ME, at their bid price of $116,000, including the $6,000 owner match. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(116-2026) To award bid 2026-035 for the Lead Abatement of 165-167 Bartlett St. to RC Group, 
Biddeford, ME, at their bid price of $89,950, including the $12,000 owner match provided by the 
CDBG rehab program funding. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(117-2026) To award bid 2026-042 for one (1) police patrol vehicle to Quirk Ford, Augusta, ME, 
at their bid price of $45,012. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                                   August 10, 2026 
(118-2026) To award bid 2026-041 for one (1) 30-ton tri-axle equipment trailer for Public Works 
to Hale Trailer, Portland, ME, at their bid price of $61,209 for a Manac 30T air ramp tag trailer. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(119-2026) To award bid 2026-037 for the Cross Canal Connector project to Starrett Snow and 
Landscape, Raymond, ME , at their estimated bid  price of $147,827.02 based on itemized costs 
using estimated quantities prepared by the Project Engineer. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(120-2026) To authorize the Task Order for Preliminary Design Services for the Randall Road 
Pump Station with Tighe & Bond for an amount not to exceed $88,000. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(121-2026) To award bid 2026-040 for the Whipple and Middle St. Utility Railroad Crossings 
project to Starrett Snow and Landscape, Raymond, ME, for an estimated bid amount of 
$904,585.58 based on itemized costs using estimated quantities prepared by the Assistant City 
Engineer. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(122-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition with Freightliner of Maine to purchase a 6 -
wheeled dump truck cab and chassis with a Viking -Cives provided body for the Sewer Dept. at 
their Sourcewell contract price of $159,050. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On motion of Ms. McCabe, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, 
 
VOTED: 
To adjourn at 6:05 p.m.
